Reading the workspace

  1. Requirements definition
  2. REQ-G60-US-ID-02

Phone integration that just works

Proposal
1, implement. Apple CarPlay (37 rows, 12 defects) and wireless charging (26 rows, level A, 11 defects, supported by the study attribute phone charging) are among the most frequent digital complaints; low CarPlay volume and the wrong phone connecting are repeated themes.
Horizon
H1. Software and charger thermal management.
Domain
Infotainment & Digital Services
Markets
US
Evidence level
A (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1

Statement

Apple CarPlay shall connect to the phone of the active driver profile, play at the same loudness as the native sources, and wireless charging shall keep the phone charged without overheating.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USCarPlay audio level vs native sourcesWithin 3 dB at the same volume stepAudio testassumption
USPhone connected at startPhone of the active profile in >= 98 % of startsFleet telemetryassumption
USWireless charging with navigation runningBattery level does not drop over 60 min at 30 °C cabinLab testassumption

      G60-3263 · Source A · US · BEV · Defect, Apple CarPlay, Connection fault · G60_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 4,094

    • the car is extremely smooth and quiet, unlike my earlier bmws. controls are straightforward, and the mix of performance and luxury is really well done. my other evs lacked a sun roof, so having one on the i5 is a big plus. the only real downside is the awful carplay audio behavior: most of the time i need the radio volume at max just to hear normally, then an incoming call can be super loud and the whole system ends up blaring because it is already turned up. lots of people online describe the same issue, and while some suggested fixes help for a while, the low volume problem keeps coming back.

      G60-3134 · Source A · US · BEV · Defect, Apple CarPlay, Malfunction · G60_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 3,941

    • after cross-shopping tesla & lucid, this felt way more solidly put together. i especially like the big range of choices for both exterior and interior. some of the tech is maddening though - i added carplay to my profile as the secondary driver, and that somehow made my wife's setup go kind of "dead". the trip computer also has fewer options than on our x5 or 328d - not having several separate "trips" is a real pain when i need to log some of them for work. we have had several problems with the charge door flap locking up, which means we can't plug in to charge. even with it set to "never lock" it still happens - this is a serius issue that almost left us stranded!

      G60-2543 · Source A · US · BEV · Defect, Apple CarPlay, Connection fault · G60_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 3,199

    • my 2025 bmw 540i does not feel as tight on the road as the bmw models i had before. there are now too many gadgets that end up being distracting. siriusxm has been changed in ways that make it harder to use. there also are no sensors on each door anymore, so i have to check that the rear doors are unlocked myself, whereas my last bmw had a fingerprint sensor that let me open the back doors. the trunk sensor almost never works the first time, i have to swing my foot 3 or 4 times before it finally opens, while on my previous bmw it worked flawlessly. my phone often will not pair, and i suspect it has something to do with apple car play. the navigation system is also not as good as the one in my earlier bmw.
